description: List announcements in a course, returning id, title, message, and posted_at for each one. Canvas serves this from the same discussion_topics index as list_discussions, filtered to topics marked is_announcement via the only_announcements query parameter. Fetches every page (100 per request) and fails with a 'Results are incomplete' error instead of silently truncating. Use create_discussion with is_announcement: true to post a new announcement, and update_discussion to edit one afterward.
name: list_announcements
title: List Announcements
